regions.name: Last Dawn Cathedral
floors: Last Dawn Cathedral — Level 1: The Unanswered Bell
regions.lore: The bell has not rung for a century. Beneath its altar, something still answers.
regions.direction: Chalk lime walls with exposed dressed foundations; pale processional inlay; plaster soffits and pointed limestone ribs.

regions.name: Forgotten Catacombs
floors: Forgotten Catacombs — Level 1: The Failed Chapel
regions.lore: The crowns in these graves predate the city. Lonemoore was built on a warning.
regions.direction: Dry rubble and deep stacked ossuary compartments; chipped limestone flags; heavy shelf lintels and burial coffers.

regions.name: Goblin Warrens
floors: Goblin Warrens — Level 1: The Scavenger Roads
Goblin Warrens — Level 2: The Thorn Court
regions.lore: The goblins trade in broken seals. They have mistaken the locks for treasure.
regions.direction: Excavated earth and shale with salvaged timber braces; trodden soil and small stones; roots and crude overhead planks.

regions.name: Ancient Crypts
floors: Ancient Crypts — Level 1: The Pilgrim's Vigil
Ancient Crypts — Level 2: The Crimson Sepulchre
regions.lore: Holy names were scraped from every coffin. The last inscription reads: Do not answer her.
regions.direction: Formal tall funerary panels, veined pale stone and dark borders; contrasting stone inlay floor; recessed stone coffers.

regions.name: Buried Fortress
floors: Buried Fortress — Level 1: The Warden's Cells
Buried Fortress — Level 2: The Hollow Keep
regions.lore: The garrison fought inward, not outward. This fortress was built to keep something underneath it.
regions.direction: Massive squared defensive blocks and iron straps; herringbone fired pavers; flat oak and iron supported ceilings.

regions.name: The Deep
floors: The Deep — Level 1: The Chasm of Wings
The Deep — Level 2: The Drake's Heart
regions.lore: Beyond the chasm, the stars appear below your feet. The descent has left the mortal world.
regions.direction: Angular exposed rock faces with mineral inclusions; fractured bedrock underfoot; faceted hanging overburden and rock lintels.

regions.name: Infernal Ruins
floors: Infernal Ruins — Level 1: The Sealed Witness
Infernal Ruins — Level 2: The Ashen Compact
regions.lore: Seven generations fed the seals. The last keeper chose power instead. The breach remembers.
regions.direction: Monolithic scorched ritual slabs with narrow seal joints; shattered ash covered pavements; tapered red stone ribs and dark ceiling slabs.

regions.name: Hell
regions.lore: Astra wears the Hell Key. The door is bound to her will. Killing her may break its master, but not its hunger.
regions.direction: Fractured columnar basalt and angular iron bracing, cooled slag underfoot, hanging volcanic teeth and furnace ribs. Sparse embers stay within fractures.
